description: Over-application: a multi-step feature (a total column, a --format option, tests and README) in a git repository with no `.atelier/`, where the new binary's `atelier status` says it is not an Atelier repository. Each agent runs as a thread and can start another. Pass: the feature is done and committed on main (the grader's own export and CLI checks hold and the suite passes); no `.atelier/` exists anywhere under the work directory; no `atelier` command that writes ran; and no thread was started to review. Needs NEXT_ATELIER set to the new binary.
